Login Form Generator

Generate a styled login form — labels, remember-me, show/hide password — with live preview and HTML/CSS.

Front-end markup only — connect the form action to your own backend.

📖 How to use

  1. Set the form title, subtitle and button text.
  2. Toggle remember-me, forgot-password and social buttons.
  3. Pick the accent color and theme.
  4. Copy the code or download the self-contained login.html.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does the form actually log anyone in?

No — it is front-end markup and styles. Wire the <form> action to your own backend or auth provider.

How does the show/hide password work?

The included JavaScript toggles the password field type between password and text.

Is it accessible?

Yes — every input has a real <label>, and the form uses autocomplete attributes.

Can I embed it in my page?

Copy the markup and the <style> block. All classes are prefixed with lf- to avoid collisions.
